## Featured Production Flagships

- [CloudDeck](https://clouddeck.dakshraman.in) ([GitHub](https://github.com/dakshraman/clouddeck)): Lightweight, open-source cloud hosting control panel. Engineered with a Go daemon and Next.js frontend to idle under 50MB RAM while managing multi-PHP (8.1–8.4), automated Let's Encrypt TLS, MariaDB, Postfix/Dovecot, and PowerDNS.
- [Borrow Nearby](https://borrownearby.in): Hyperlocal peer-to-peer mobile marketplace in production on iOS and Android. Features sub-50ms PostGIS geospatial queries, real-time WebSocket chat, and escrow protections.
- [Devkit](https://devkit.dakshraman.in) ([GitHub](https://github.com/dakshraman/devkit)): Zero-dependency TypeScript utility toolkit. 1.4KB gzipped core for cryptographic tokens, type-inferred contract validation, and timing-attack-resistant comparisons.
- [Advanced School ERP](https://erp-web-lctn.onrender.com/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/dakshraman/schoolerp-parent)): Enterprise campus operations management system built with Laravel, managing student admissions, automated report cards, Razorpay fee reconciliation, and 5-tier RBAC for 500+ active campus members.
- [Laravel AI Debugger](https://github.com/dakshraman/laravel-ai-debugger): Open-source AI debugging assistant for Laravel applications (800+ GitHub stars).
